selected_leaf: Derive the minimal durable checkpoint schema and transition guard that preserves exact target_scope T, witness w, payload digest d, protocol state, and last verifier classification across restart, and prove that no restart path can rotate w or authorize a second logical effect before COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Abstract recurring-Chat protocols using the predecessor Stage T verifier and commit-attempt protocol, where a role-local checkpoint can be durably CAS-written/read back before a target-side attempt and the target provides either atomic same-witness idempotence or atomic create-if-absent for exact (T,w,d). No concrete product/API is claimed to satisfy these semantics.

minimal_checkpoint_schema.logical_effect_id: immutable identifier for the one intended logical effect; binds every restart to the same unresolved effect
minimal_checkpoint_schema.target_scope_T: immutable exact target scope or canonical digest
minimal_checkpoint_schema.payload_digest_d: immutable canonical digest of the intended payload
minimal_checkpoint_schema.protocol_state: one of VERIFY_BEFORE_ATTEMPT, ATTEMPT_ARMED, VERIFY_PENDING, COMMITTED, CONFLICT, UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE
minimal_checkpoint_schema.last_verifier_class: one of NONE, COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE, CONFLICT, UNRESOLVED_UNVERIFIABLE_SOURCE, UNRESOLVED_NOT_PROOF, UNRESOLVED_AMBIGUOUS
minimal_checkpoint_schema.attempt_may_have_occurred: boolean; true in ATTEMPT_ARMED or VERIFY_PENDING after an attempt boundary may have been crossed
minimal_checkpoint_schema.checkpoint_revision: monotonic role-local CAS revision used only to reject stale checkpoint replacement; it never authorizes witness rotation

minimality_argument: logical_effect_id is required to distinguish continuation of the same unresolved effect from a genuinely new effect after terminal resolution.
T,w,d are required because restart safety is defined for exact target scope, witness and payload; losing any one can silently broaden scope or change effect identity.
protocol_state is required to distinguish pre-attempt verification, an attempt that may have crossed the crash boundary, pending verification, and terminal outcomes.
last_verifier_class is required because only target-authoritative COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT may terminally resolve the effect; cached/local success is insufficient.
target_commit_semantics is required to decide whether exact same-witness retry can be safe; without it an ambiguous restart must fail closed.
attempt_may_have_occurred is the one-bit crash-window memory that makes ATTEMPT_ARMED conservative: after restart the protocol assumes the mutation may already have happened.
checkpoint_revision is required only for stale-local-state rejection under CAS; no timestamp, retry counter, queue id, or transport acknowledgement is needed for the safety invariant.

transition_guard.immutable_binding_guard: While logical_effect_id is nonterminal, every transition must preserve exact T,w,d. Any proposed transition with different T, w or d is rejected before target mutation.
transition_guard.arm_before_effect_guard: A target mutation may be attempted only after an ATTEMPT_ARMED checkpoint containing exact logical_effect_id,T,w,d,target_commit_semantics has been durably written and exact-read back. ATTEMPT_ARMED means the effect may already have happened even if the process crashes immediately afterward.
transition_guard.restart_guard: On restart from ATTEMPT_ARMED or VERIFY_PENDING, never mint or substitute a witness. First re-run the frozen verifier for exact T,w,d. COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE -> COMMITTED; CONFLICT -> CONFLICT; unresolved evidence remains nonterminal.
transition_guard.retry_guard: If restart verification is unresolved, exact same-(T,w,d) retry is permitted only when target_commit_semantics=ATOMIC_SAME_WITNESS_IDEMPOTENT. For ATOMIC_CREATE_IF_ABSENT, a new create attempt is permitted only when the target supplies the protocol's required current authoritative nonexistence precondition and atomic create-if-absent still binds exact w,d. With NONE, no mutation is permitted.
transition_guard.terminal_guard: Witness rotation for the same logical_effect_id is permanently forbidden. A different witness may appear only under a distinct new logical_effect_id after the prior effect is terminally COMMITTED or CONFLICT and a later recurrence selects a genuinely new logical effect.
transition_guard.stale_checkpoint_guard: A checkpoint whose CAS predecessor/revision is stale may be read as historical evidence but cannot replace the current checkpoint or authorize target mutation. The current durable checkpoint wins mechanically; no same-run CAS spin is required.

restart_state_table.allowed: verifier read only; if mutation is eventually safe, persist/readback ATTEMPT_ARMED first
treat attempt as possibly executed; verifier-first; same-witness mutation only under the retry guard
verifier-first; same-witness mutation only under the retry guard

safety_proof_sketch: Before the first possible target mutation, the exact effect identity (logical_effect_id,T,w,d) is already durable in ATTEMPT_ARMED, so a crash cannot erase or replace the witness identity used by that attempt.
Every nonterminal restart transition has immutable_binding_guard, therefore no restart path can rotate w or change d/T for the same intended effect.
If an attempt crossed the crash window, restart from ATTEMPT_ARMED/VERIFY_PENDING must verify exact T,w,d before mutation. Proven commit and conflict are terminal no-mutation states.

If verification is unresolved, any permitted retry uses the same T,w,d and is allowed only under a target atomicity contract that collapses same-witness attempts or guarantees create-if-absent uniqueness. Therefore a retry cannot create a second logical effect within the tested abstract contract.
If the target lacks the required atomicity contract, unresolved restart paths permit no mutation. Thus the protocol fails closed rather than creating a duplicate effect.

Consequently, for the tested abstract scope, crash/restart can cause verifier replay or a target-collapsed same-witness retry, but cannot authorize witness rotation or a second logical target effect before COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT.
unresolved_conditions: A concrete target must be audited to verify that its idempotency/create-if-absent primitive is target-enforced and atomic over the exact effect scope; client-only labels are insufficient.
A concrete target must expose target-authoritative durable evidence sufficient for the predecessor verifier after crash; write idempotence without trustworthy readback remains unresolved.

The next local proof obligation is to derive a verifier-compatible recovery algorithm for stale checkpoint versus newer target evidence, including the exact precedence rule when local checkpoint state lags a target-authoritative COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE observation.
